description: This file defines a React functional component named TaskCard, which renders a task as a card with controls for editing, completing, and deleting the task. It utilizes React hooks for state management and ref handling, and integrates with a task store through custom hooks. The component handles user interactions such as toggling completion, inline editing of task titles, and displaying task categories and due dates.

methods.name: TaskCard
methods.description: React component that displays a task card with controls for editing, completing, and deleting a task.

methods.name: onSave
methods.description: Handles saving the edited task title, updating the task store if the title has changed.
